from solution import heap_replace


def test_issue_example_from_spec():
    """Delete smallest then insert new item as in the given example."""
    result = heap_replace([25, 44, 68, 21, 39, 23, 89], 21)
    assert result == [21, 25, 23, 44, 39, 68, 89]  # heapify -> [21,25,23,44,39,68,89], pop 21 push 21 unchanged


def test_issue_replace_larger_sifts_down():
    """Delete smallest then insert new item requiring sift-down."""
    result = heap_replace([1, 3, 2], 4)
    assert result == [2, 3, 4]  # root 1->4 gives [4,3,2], min child 2 swaps: [2,3,4]


def test_issue_replace_smaller_stays_at_root():
    """Delete smallest then insert new item smaller than all stays on top."""
    result = heap_replace([5, 6, 7], 1)
    assert result == [1, 6, 7]  # root 5->1 gives [1,6,7], 1 < 6 and 1 < 7 so no swap


def test_issue_replace_equal_middle_value():
    """Delete smallest then insert new item equal to an existing child."""
    result = heap_replace([1, 2, 3], 2)
    assert result == [2, 2, 3]  # root 1->2 gives [2,2,3], 2 <= 2 and 2 <= 3 so no swap


def test_issue_single_element_smaller():
    """Delete smallest then insert new item into single-element heap."""
    result = heap_replace([10], 7)
    assert result == [7]  # pop 10 push 7 -> [7]


def test_issue_single_element_larger():
    """Delete smallest then insert larger item into single-element heap."""
    result = heap_replace([10], 20)
    assert result == [20]  # pop 10 push 20 -> [20]


def test_issue_deep_siftdown_two_levels():
    """Delete smallest then insert new item sinking two levels."""
    result = heap_replace([1, 3, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7], 10)
    assert result == [2, 3, 6, 4, 5, 10, 7]  # [10,3,2,4,5,6,7] swap 10<->2 -> [2,3,10,4,5,6,7] swap 10<->6 -> [2,3,6,4,5,10,7]


def test_issue_duplicate_values():
    """Delete smallest then insert new item when all values are equal."""
    result = heap_replace([2, 2, 2], 2)
    assert result == [2, 2, 2]  # pop one 2 push 2 -> [2,2,2]


def test_contract_length_unchanged():
    """Deleting smallest then inserting must keep the heap size the same."""
    result = heap_replace([2, 5, 3], 9)
    assert len(result) == 3  # 3 items - 1 + 1 = 3


def test_contract_heap_property_holds():
    """Result must still satisfy the heap invariant parent <= children."""
    result = heap_replace([4, 8, 5, 9, 10, 6], 7)
    assert all(result[(i - 1) // 2] <= result[i] for i in range(1, len(result)))  # pop 4 push 7 -> expect [5,8,6,9,10,7] which is a valid heap


def test_contract_old_min_removed_new_present():
    """Deleting smallest then inserting must remove min and contain the new item."""
    result = heap_replace([1, 2, 3], 5)
    assert sorted(result) == [2, 3, 5]  # remove 1 add 5: [2,3] + [5] sorted = [2,3,5]
